messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "may increase risk of muscle problems"
set: ["may increase risk of muscle problems", "this can increase the risk of serious muscle problems", "may increase risk of eclampsia", "may increase risk of unintended pregnancy", "may increase risk of complications in newborn", "may increase risk of low birth weight", "alcohol may increase risk of liver damage", "taking certain oral diabetes medicines may increase risk of serious heart problems", "may increase risk of heavy bleeding after delivery", "may increase risk of severe bleeding after childbirth", "uncontrolled asthma may increase risk of premature birth", "hypothyroidism during pregnancy may increase risk of miscarriage", "long term use may increase risk of broken bone", "increased risk of breathing problems", "osteoporosis risk increase", "increased risk of serious muscle problems when used with certain drugs"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
